newsitem.title: NORWAY: No restart of Snorre oil flow before Friday - Saga.
newsitem.headline: No restart of Snorre oil flow before Friday - Saga.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Wednesday crude production at the Snorre oilfield in the North Sea would not resume before Friday afternoon.
Earlier the company said it planned to restart on Thursday or Friday.
Output at the 200,000 barrel-per-day development was shut in on Sunday when a short circuit in the main power system caused a black out.
The main system was restarted on Tuesday, but the platform's auxilliary generators developed a malfunction. Safety regulations require that both systems function before production can restart.

"Repairs on the auxilliary units are taking longer than expected," said Saga spokesman Bjoern Schibevaag. "But a production start is planned for Friday afternoon if the repair work at the auxilliary plant is completed by that time."
